visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation begins with a character featuring long blue hair lying horizontally in bed, clutching a glowing purple smartphone. Then, an orange stick figure is shown in a dimly lit office environment with a purple filing cabinet and a wall clock, yawning extensively with an open mouth. (3) Transition to '24 hours' with two red stars. A yellow stick figure appears ecstatic with a crown of yellow sparkles and a wide smile, set against a vibrant pink and orange geometric background. (4) A dark purple title card appears followed by a figure looking sluggish and tired. A medical graphic of a pink brain is shown, with white particles labeled as 'amyloid beta' being highlighted as waste products. (5) '36 hours' with four stars; a red stick figure stands against a bright orange background with flames above its head, pulling at its face and eyes in a state of high distress. (8) '2 weeks' text card; the character is slumped against a dark grey wall in a dim room. A black-robed grim reaper with a white skull and a scythe appears in a window-like frame behind them. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 維維. [Subtitle]: 如果不睡覺會發生什麼事?. (2) [Subtitle]: 16小時. [Subtitle]: 如果持續不睡覺. [Subtitle]: 16小時後. [Subtitle]: 會開始感到疲倦. [Subtitle]: 頻繁打哈欠. (3) [Subtitle]: 24小時. [Subtitle]: 大腦反而. [Subtitle]: 釋放多巴胺. [Subtitle]: 精神變好. (4) [Subtitle]: 短暫的快樂期後. [Subtitle]: 血液酒精濃度上升. [Subtitle]: 像喝醉一樣. [Subtitle]: 大腦功能下降. [Subtitle]: 並且無法清除. [Subtitle]: 大腦中的廢物. (5) [Subtitle]: 36小時. [Subtitle]: 情緒控制力變差. [Subtitle]: 專注力崩壞. [Subtitle]: 開始頻繁出錯. (6) [Subtitle]: 48小時. [Subtitle]: 免疫系統急遽下滑. [Subtitle]: 許多身體機能. [Subtitle]: 開始關閉. [Subtitle]: 不時斷片. (7) [Subtitle]: 72小時. [Subtitle]: 強烈的疲勞感. [Subtitle]: 揮之不去. [Subtitle]: 身體不斷啃食所有. [Subtitle]: 能找到的能量. [Subtitle]: 思緒混亂. [Subtitle]: 甚至出現幻覺. [Subtitle]: 和解離狀態. (8) [Subtitle]: 2個星期. [Subtitle]: 2個星期後. [Subtitle]: 免疫系統非常脆弱. [Subtitle]: 頭疼感冒或. [Subtitle]: 致命疾病直接攀上. [Subtitle]: 死神在你周圍. [Subtitle]: 準備待命. (9) [Subtitle]: 3個星期. [Subtitle]: 3個星期後. [Subtitle]: 心臟運作到極限. [Subtitle]: 死亡. (10) [Subtitle]: 以上是根據. [Subtitle]: 科學研究的假設. [Subtitle]: 大家不要挑戰喔.

The speech rate increases slightly to reflect stress and urgency, while the synth-heavy BGM provides a stable rhythmic backbone without any background noise interference. (6) A digital glissando SFX marks the next phase. The vocal delivery becomes softer in volume to simulate a lack of energy, while the electronic drums continue to provide a high-percussive texture in the mix. The narrator's voice has a subtle processing effect to simulate disorientation, perfectly synced with the psychedelic visuals described elsewhere, over the persistent BGM loop. The vocal tone becomes grave and measured, emphasizing medical dangers; the recording remains pristine with no digital distortion or technical artifacts. The background music ducks out almost completely to provide dramatic silence for the finality of the statement, creating a high-contrast dynamic moment. (10) The music resumes its neutral, upbeat loop. The narrator returns to a friendly, informative tone to deliver the concluding remarks and disclaimer, with excellent enunciation and a balanced mix ratio.
